purpose: Normalize every registered Film & TV source into an authority class and require academic secondary evidence for claim types that depend on research rather than primary, legal, archival or institutional documentation alone.

authority_classes.peer_reviewed_scholarship: Peer-reviewed journal research or equivalent peer-reviewed scholarly publication.
authority_classes.scholarly_book: Academic monograph, scholarly handbook, university-press chapter or equivalent research synthesis.
authority_classes.primary_source: Contemporaneous or first-party object, statement, production record, programme, interview, dataset or other direct evidence.
authority_classes.official_statistics: Official, regulator, public-body or established institutional research/statistics with a defined method, population or administrative basis.
authority_classes.law_regulation: Legislation, regulation, court or treaty material, regulator rule, formal policy framework or authoritative legal guidance.
authority_classes.archive_institution: Archive, library, museum, cinematheque, catalogue, preservation body or collection documentation used for provenance, object, version or heritage claims.
authority_classes.professional_secondary: Professional, industry, standards-body, trade, festival, educational or other secondary source that is useful but is not automatically academic research.
